description_en: Queries the list of AI model providers under a specified AgentTeams instance. Paging is supported
description_zh: 用于查询指定 AgentTeams 实例下的 AI 模型供应商列表，支持分页查询
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams list-model-providers --instance-id AgentTeams --max-results 20 --next-token nt-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListModelProviders

parameters.help_en: Optional. Fuzzy matches by instance name
parameters.help_zh: 可选，按实例名称模糊匹配
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 分页 Token，用于获取下一页数据
parameters.name: next_token
